$comment: The role policy for StudyBuddy's custom agents, owned by the security team. Each agent has one role; a role says what it may do (read, search, edit, execute, web, agent, todo, mcp:read, mcp:write) and whether only a person or a script may start it ("invocation": "explicit"). Read by scripts/audit-agents.mjs. It lives outside .github/agents/ on purpose: Copilot loads every .md file in there as an agent.

reviewer.why: Eyes, not hands: it reports, and someone else acts.

test-writer.why: Writes and runs tests; which files it may touch is up to its instructions.

fixer.why: Changes code and runs the tests; the review decides what to fix.

docs.why: Writes text; it never needs to run anything.

triage.why: Sorts reports; a person decides what happens next.

release.why: Runs commands, so it only runs when a person asks for it.

portal-reader.why: Answers from the portal; it never changes it.

coverage.why: Runs the tests with coverage and reports; it changes nothing.
